issues.on_page: Payments in-lieu of taxes and franchise taxes 1,702,567
issues.issue: A mixed In Lieu of Tax and franchise tax line is recorded as generic 'taxes'. The rules for mixed lines call for the dominant category plus review. The budget-basis figures (p5: in-lieu 985,563, franchise 656,443) suggest In Lieu of Tax dominates, but they don't tie to the GAAP amount, so this is a judgment call.

issues.extracted: category 'licenses and permits' / detail_category 'other charges for services'
issues.issue: The category and detail_category disagree for the same mixed line. The GAAP statement (p4) shows charges for services and fees (5,630,758 + 2,258,191) dominating permits and licenses (1,751,777) in the General Fund, so the dominant category may be charges for services/fees.

This mixed line is called dominantly reimbursements, but the GAAP General Fund column (p4) shows Miscellaneous 425,406 larger than Reimbursements 132,676. The budget-basis makeup is not printed, so the dominant part is uncertain.
The label is not in the 'Capital Outlay: <function>' form the capital outlay rule calls for. The page prints no function, so plain 'Capital outlay' is defensible.
